overrides.reason: Posthumous award, granted by hand as a deliberate exception to the sole-claimant rule. Deetdee met every criterion on their own (Graded, 1st in A Finals, oshi quote filled, both screenshots submitted) and their win is confirmed by their own podium row (is_user=True, placement=1, 2:10.3). The automatic rule dropped them only because Shen also submitted a qualifying A-Finals win on the same [Stone-Piercing Blue] Grass Wonder, making the uma non-unique. Shen's claim looks equally genuine (a distinct build in the statsheet), so this override intentionally does NOT extend to them; it is a one-off in Deetdee's memory rather than a change to the rule.
